name: dataset Fourier spectrum predicts fixed-budget learnability
hypothesis: A compact spectrum measured from the dataset before training predicts fixed-budget held-out cross-entropy and learning-curve area on unseen corpora; positional encoding moderates but does not define the dataset descriptor.

text_spectrum.support_bank: all 21 unordered pairs of the frozen lag bank
text_spectrum.scope: exact within every support; monotone support-bank lower envelope, not the complete degree-two context spectrum

image_panel.role: separate development and corrected-curve panel; not pooled numerically with text
image_panel.dct_basis: orthonormal two-dimensional DCT-II on 32x32 grayscale images

exact_factorial.rule: uniform block contexts with noisy modular categorical target
exact_factorial.purpose: independently identify signal-energy, interaction-degree, and support-radius effects

outcomes.primary_endpoint: median-seed final held-out CE divided by initial held-out CE
outcomes.primary_curve: median-seed normalized held-out CE curve area

models.neural_network_role: diagnostic only; not used for the low-data confirmatory verdict
models.splitting: nested leave-one-corpus-out; seeds and transforms remain inside their corpus group

verdict.strong_support: frozen Fourier predictor has positive unseen-corpus R2 for both primary outcomes and at least 5% corpus-balanced RMSE improvement over the best non-Fourier baseline with positive corpus-bootstrap confidence intervals
verdict.predictive_not_unique: both outcomes beat configuration-only but not the best non-Fourier baseline

compute.staging: profiles and predictions are hash-frozen before confirmatory training outcomes are opened
